expectedIssues: Orders icon is missing from the bottom nav bar
reportedIssues: In the first 'Fastest near you' card (Green Bowl Poké), the '15–25 min' badge overlaps the plate image and looks misaligned. The badge sits over the plate edge and its position looks inconsistent with the other cards, where it sits on a dark background.

The secondary gray text (delivery fees, 'Ramen', '(500+)') and the placeholder text in the search field have low contrast against the white and light-gray backgrounds. The inactive tab labels are also light gray.

The promo banner's decorative translucent circles are cut off and the lower one has a hard edge at the bottom-right corner, which looks like a rendering artifact. The white 'Order now' text on the mid-green gradient is also fairly low in contrast at the lighter end.

The favorite heart buttons are inconsistent. The ramen card's button has a dark circular background, while the pizza card's button has a semi-transparent brown circle with different sizing and offset. The white heart outline also has weak contrast on the light image areas.
